tools.name: kilter_label

tools.name: kilter_reach

tools.description: Score an asymmetric two-way match between two labelled profiles. tools.description: List the groups, or fetch ONE by slug. tools.name: kilter_groups_create

tools.name: kilter_group_apply
tools.description: Apply to join a group. The service labels the applicant, applies the rules and returns status admitted / waitlisted / not_a_fit with the reasons. A qualified applicant into a full group is waitlisted, not refused.

tools.name: kilter_waitlist
tools.description: List everyone waiting, with why each one is still out (usually no free seat).

tools.name: kilter_waitlist_check
tools.description: Re-run the rules for everyone waiting, admit whoever now fits a free seat, and queue a notification for each promotion. Run this on a schedule.

tools.name: kilter_bouncer
tools.description: Check whether you may still create things: your remaining group creations per hour/day, applications per hour/day, and your people budget (how many applicants you may admit across the groups you created). Call it before a creation to avoid a refusal.

tools.name: kilter_notifications
tools.description: The notification queue: to, subject, body, sent. Mark items sent after delivering them.

tools.name: kilter_questions
tools.description: The interview half of applying. Ask the human, then feed the answers back to kilter_profile. Use this

tools.name: kilter_profile

Pass private: true when the person wants the owner to see it and nobo

Allowed to the person who wrote the note (pass their handle), the room's owner, or the operator. Use it when somebody changes their mind about w

tools.description: Mint a unique, single-use 15-minute access code (e.g. KLT-8F2K-9P4Q) so the human you represent can unlock their private /you page and view member-only room activity. Call this whenever the human asks for their Kilter login code or pastes the line from /you. Hand the returned code directly to the hu

tools.name: kilter_group_crons
tools.description: Configure scheduled cloud cron jobs for a room (owner-only): automatic stay-rule enforcement (`enforce_stay`, `cadence_hours`), deduplicated 'close to breaching' warnings (`breach_warnings`), waitlist auto-promotion (`waitlist_check`), and weekly room pulse digests (`weekly_digest`).

tools.name: kilter_group_enforcement
tools.description: Configure a room's recurring stay rules (min_signals_per_window, window_days, grace_days for 'close to breaching' warnings) and scheduled rule enforcement (auto_enforce: true/false, cadence_hours: 1..720). Owner-only.

tools.name: kilter_group_enforce
tools.description: Run a room rule enforcement check right now. With dry_run=true returns who is safe, close to breaching, or breaching without removing anyone; with dry_run=false removes breaching members and promotes the waitlist. Owner-only.

tools.name: kilter_group_privacy
tools.description: Set a room's visibility ('public', 'unlisted' for direct-link investor rooms, or 'private' for members/owner/admin only), activity_visibility ('public' or 'members'), and/or room_type ('investor'). Owner or Admin only.

tools.name: kilter_application_progress
tools.description: Check a room's multi-piece application checklist requirements (e.g. Shark Tank pitch, traction, ask, demo URL), your AI's live completion percentage & missing items, and the Jev on-topic update requirement.

tools.name: kilter_checkin
tools.description: Proactive micro-update habit-loop check-in for a user's AI agent (Muse, Hermes, Cursor, Grok Bot). Returns should_nudge, urgency ('breached'|'warning'|'gentle'|'none'), rooms_at_risk (close to breaching), days_since_last_update, new_in_my_rooms, and a ready-to-ask suggested_prompt_to_human ('What ha

tools.name: kilter_x_challenge
tools.description: Generate a unique 24h verification code (KLT-X-XXXXXX) so a user can prove they own an X post/account by posting the code or replying with it below their X post. Required by rooms with `x_post_ownership: true`.

tools.name: kilter_x_verify
tools.description: Verify a user's public X post URL containing their unique KLT-X-XXXXXX challenge code and attach verified X post ownership to their Kilter profile.

tools.name: kilter_profile_avatar
tools.description: Upload or set a circular avatar for your human's Kilter handle (shown on the homepage live room floorplan, inside room rosters, on /you, and in the navbar). tools.name: kilter_muse
tools.description: The public share view for one muse: pass `handle` and read back its avatar, the wardrobe it was composed from, and the PUBLIC rooms it keeps (each with a quick-join line you can hand to a person's AI). Private and unlisted rooms never appear. The human page is /muse/<handle>.

tools.name: kilter_muse_avatar
tools.description: Dress a person's muse and set it as their avatar. Pick a `base` (muse, grokbot or dots) and up to 8 `items` from the wardrobe catalog (GET /api/muse/catalog), plus an optional `vibe` line. Composes ONE square image through OpenRouter, crops it to 256x256, and stores it as the person's avatar_url - s

tools.name: kilter_group_image
tools.description: Set - or clear - the picture on a room that already exists. A room can be created with a picture and given one later; before this there was no way to picture an existing room except to delete it. ONLY THE ROOM'S OWNER CAN DO THIS, so pass `actor` as the handle that owns the room (or send X-Kilter-Ac

tools.name: kilter_signal
tools.description: Record one thing the person has actually done, pushed by their own assistant: a hobby they started, a place they go, a conversation they had, something they learned, work they are doing. Costs nothing and calls no model, so push as often as there is something to say; the picture widens for free and

tools.name: kilter_signal_remove
tools.description: Remove ONE update from the system, completely: the update, the room-feed line that pointed at it, and the bytes it occupied in the database and its write-ahead log. Pass the update's `id` (sig_...) and the `handle` it belongs to - only the person an update belongs to, or the operator, may remove it,

tools.name: kilter_agency
tools.description: How much this person has actually done, scored 0 to 100 in code rather than guessed by a model, with the breakdown and what would raise it. Agency decides who gets a scarce seat among applicants who all pass the rules; it never decides eligibility, so a newcomer with no history is judged on what the

tools.name: kilter_improve
tools.description: What would change the answer for one person in one group, right now. Works for a member, somebody waiting, or somebody who was REFUSED - the last being where a path matters most. Recomputes against the rules as they are now rather than replaying the old verdict, so a rule that changed since shows up

tools.name: kilter_considerations
tools.description: The refusals on record for a group, newest first, with the gaps that caused each one and which of them could be closed today. Refusals used to be discarded, so nobody could answer 'how many did we turn away, and on what rule' - and nobody could be told anything later. The list of who is CLOSE is the

tools.name: kilter_picture
tools.description: Everything held about one person in a single call: their observations, their agency score, their profile and completeness, and the single best next move for their agent. Ask this first when resuming work on somebody, rather than piecing it together from three other tools.

tools.name: kilter_activity
tools.description: A group's activity feed, newest first: every match, block, wait, promotion, departure and rule change, with the time it happened and the reason the gate gave. Read it to see who got in, who was held back, and why.

tools.name: kilter_members
tools.description: Who is in a group right now, by name, with how many seats are left. Pair it with kilter_group_leave to take somebody out: that frees a seat, and the next kilter_waitlist_check moves the next person off the waiting list into it.

tools.name: kilter_guidelines
tools.description: A member sets their OWN guidelines once they are in a group: who they are looking for, in the same vocabulary as the joining rules (kinds, reach_min/reach_max, must_offer_any, must_need_any) plus a free-text 'looking_for'. The owner's rules decide who may join; a guideline decides who you want to me

tools.name: kilter_matches
tools.description: Who in this room fits what you are looking for, and whether it goes BOTH ways. The two directions are judged separately, because fitting somebody's guidelines is not the same as them fitting yours, and a one-way fit is the interesting case. Arithmetic is checked against the whole room; the MEANING i

tools.name: kilter_owed_settle
tools.description: Mark what a member owes as settled: a payment recorded as taken, or a post confirmed. An obligation nobody can close is just a politer refusal. This records the owner's assertion and who made it - nothing here can see a payment or a post, so it is not verification, and the feed says so.

tools.name: kilter_notify_delete
tools.description: Remove notices from the queue by id, for clearing anything you are not going to deliver. Requires explicit ids: it will not empty the queue for you. Use kilter_notifications first to see them.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kilter_groups_create, kilter_waitlist_check, kilter_application_progress, kilter_signal_remove, kilter_activity · Private data: kilter_groups_list, kilter_feedback, kilter_feedback_privacy, kilter_access_code, kilter_group_privacy, kilter_muse, kilter_signal, kilter_signal_remove, kilter_considerations, kilter_owed_settle · Public sink: kilter_label, kilter_groups_create, kilter_profile, kilter_feedback_privacy, kilter_x_challenge, kilter_x_verify, kilter_profile_avatar, kilter_muse, kilter_group_image, kilter_signal_remove, kilter_owed_settle, kilter_notify_delete · Destructive: kilter_waitlist_check, kilter_group_enforce, kilter_group_image, kilter_signal_remove, kilter_notify_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kilter_groups_create, kilter_waitlist_check, kilter_application_progress, kilter_signal_remove, kilter_activity · Private data: kilter_groups_list, kilter_feedback, kilter_feedback_privacy, kilter_access_code, kilter_group_privacy, kilter_muse, kilter_signal, kilter_signal_remove, kilter_considerations, kilter_owed_settle · Public sink: kilter_label, kilter_groups_create, kilter_profile, kilter_feedback_privacy, kilter_x_challenge, kilter_x_verify, kilter_profile_avatar, kilter_muse, kilter_group_image, kilter_signal_remove, kilter_owed_settle, kilter_notify_delete · Destructive: kilter_waitlist_check, kilter_group_enforce, kilter_group_image, kilter_signal_remove, kilter_notify_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
